title: a16z Podcast: Startups, Pivots, Culture, and Timing (Oh Shit!)

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: The hardest thing about pivots (major shifts in company/product direction) isn't just the actual pivot.
reader_summary.overview: The hardest thing about pivots (major shifts in company/product direction) isn't just the actual pivot. It's the courage to make the decision... and being honest with yourself as a CEO. Especially since, no matter how great the team or board or even customers may be, it's lonely.

key_points.text: Especially since, no matter how great the team or board or even customers may be, it's lonely.
And sigh, "pivot" has also become such an overused word, it's certainly lost nuance, and perhaps even meaning.
So what does "pivoting" a startup really mean?
